- Register results, get tables and award winners.
- Create and administer groups of friends, and invite them to competitions.
- Keep your events and groups private, or make them public to attract new players.





Simply log in to the app using your phone number, then create a competition and invite your friends, register results, and earn ranking points. If you play on a regular basis, it is better to organise your friends in a group and create competitions exclusively for the group. Everyone in the group gets an invite, and as admin you can follow how many have signed up and how many are on the reserves list. If a player skips out, the reserve automatically gets a notification to take that slot.


When starting the competition, the rounds and matches are generated automatically. Each match has a predicted result based on the ranking of all players. Beating the ranking earns points, and vice versa. Competitions and groups also display an average ranking based on all players, making it easier to find suitable groups to play with.
